results.title: Luda Technology Group Limited (LUD.US) Announces Entry into Mongolia-China Coal Trading Business and Long-Term Commodity Trading Strategy
results.description: HONG KONG, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Luda Technology Group Limited (NYSE American: LUD) (the "Company" or "Luda Technology"), a manufacturer and trader of stainless steel and carbon steel flanges and fittings products, today announced its entry into the Mongolia-China coal trading business. The Company has entered into agreements with two customers in the Chinese market for the supply of, in aggregate, 440,000 metric tons of Mongolian thermal coal over one year, comprising of 220,000 metric tons per customer. For each customer, the commitments cover 20,000 metric tons to be supplied through November 30, 2026, and an additional 200,000 metric tons through October 14, 2027. These agreements mark the Company's expansion into commodity trading and provide the foundation for a broader long-term strategy focused on energy, metals, and marketable mineral products. To support and meet these customer commitments, Luda has also entered into a supply agreement with a Mongolian company to source thermal coal originating from Tsogttsetsii, South Gobi Province, Mongolia. Luda will act as the trading intermediary between the Mongolian supplier and the two customers in China. Together, the purchase and sale agreements establish quantity commitments from both supplier and buyer but do not fix a unit price or total contract value. Pricing is subject to market conditions and confirmation before payment and shipment of each ordered batch. Through the initial customer agreements, Luda aims to establish procedures for quality testing, weight verification, and settlements to provide an operational framework for these trading activities. Luda views its entry into the coal trading business as the first step in developing a broader, cross-border commodity trading platform. The Company intends to leverage capabilities developed through the execution of the agreements, including sourcing, quality control, logistics coordination, cross-border transaction management, and customer relationships to support the future growth and expansion of its commodity trading operations. Over time, Luda plans to evaluate opportunities across a wider range of energy, metals, and mineral commodities, including fluorspar, tungsten, iron ore and copper products. Any expansion beyond coal will depend on market demand, supplier relationships, financing requirements, regulatory considerations, and transaction economics. The Company has not yet entered into definitive agreements for these additional products unless otherwise announced. Ma Biu, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Luda Technology Group, commented: "Our entry into the Mongolia-China coal trading business represents an important first step in establishing our commodity trading business and is intended to further diversify revenue streams beyond our core operations. Our immediate focus is successful execution of the contracted coal volumes, disciplined risk management, and building a reliable and foundational operating platform that can scale beyond coal trading. As we begin developing the necessary commercial relationships, we intend to evaluate opportunities to expand into additional energy, metals, and mineral commodities that can complement our trading operations and capabilities. Our objective is to build a diversified commodity trading business through carefully selected transactions supported by market demand and sound commercial fundamentals." results.title: Mirae Asset Celebrates Inclusion of Global X China Life Franklin HK-US Equity Select ETF (3428) as an Eligible ETF under Southbound Stock Connect
results.description: Inclusion expands Global X's Southbound ETF Connect line-up to 4 eligible ETFs Eligible Mainland investors will be able to begin trading the Fund through Southbound Stock Connect on 9 November 2026. Global X China Life Franklin HK-US Equity Select ETF (3428) offers combined exposure to Hong Kong high-dividend equities with leading U.S. mega-cap companies in one ETF. HONG KONG, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mirae Asset Global Investments (Hong Kong) Limited ("Mirae Asset"), through its Global X ETFs brand, is pleased to announce the inclusion of the Global X China Life Franklin HK-US Equity Select ETF (the "Fund"; HKD counter: 3428; RMB counter: 83428; USD counter: 9428) under Southbound Stock Connect. Eligible Mainland investors are expected to begin trading the Fund through the programme on 9 November 2026. The Fund seeks to track the CSI Select Market Moderate Index, which combines 65% Hong Kong-listed high-dividend equities with 35% leading U.S.-listed mega-cap companies across 45 securities. For eligible Mainland investors seeking both income-oriented exposure and participation in global innovation, the Fund brings these complementary investment themes together within a single, rules-based strategy. The inclusion will bring the number of Global X ETFs available through Southbound Stock Connect to four, joining the Global X Hang Seng TECH ETF (2837), Global X Hang Seng High Dividend Yield ETF (3110) and Global X MSCI China ETF (3040). For more information about the Global X China Life Franklin HK-US Equity Select ETF (3428), please visit Global X ETFs website at www.globalxetfs.com.hk/funds/china-life-franklin-hk-us-equity-select-etf/ About Mirae Asset Global Investments Founded in 1997, Mirae Asset Global Investments is the asset management arm of Mirae Asset Financial Group, one of Asia's leading independent financial services companies. results.title: Ericsson brings drone detection capabilities to mobile networks
results.description: Ericsson introduces new Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) System The system accurately detects and tracks moving objects such as drones over wide areas, including those not connected to the network Selected small-scale, sensing-only commercial pilots expected to begin in 2027. Wider scale sensing deployments expected to follow in 2028 STOCKHOLM, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Existing mobile networks can help close a gap in detecting low-flying, fast-moving objects such as drones across wide areas. Following successful testing of Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) technology over the past months, Ericsson (NASDAQ: ERIC) today introduces the Ericsson ISAC System. The new solution adds sensing capabilities to the mobile network, enabling defense, public safety and critical infrastructure operators to detect and track moving objects, even when they are not connected to the network. Commercial introduction of the Ericsson ISAC System will take place in phases, beginning with small-scale, sensing-only commercial pilots with selected customers in 2027, followed by broader-scale deployments from 2028. The integrated communications capability will be added as the solution evolves towards 6G. Small, low-cost drones are increasingly being used for unlawful surveillance, organized crime, sabotage, and warfare. Their size and flight behavior at low altitudes make them difficult to detect, which creates new challenges for national security, critical infrastructure protection, and public safety. Dedicated sensors will remain important for protecting critical sites but scaling them across larger areas may be challenging due to the significant new infrastructure required. The Ericsson ISAC System closes the low-altitude, wide-area detection gap by transforming the mobile network into a new layer of situational awareness. Using sensing-capable 5G radios, edge computing, AI and signal processing, it detects objects that are not connected to the network and maintains tracks across the coverage area, complementing radar and other sensors rather than replacing them. How it works Ericsson ISAC System detects and tracks objects by analyzing how radio signals are reflected by objects in the environment. It operates as a multi-static system, which means that sensing signal transmission and reception are distributed across multiple geographically separate mobile-network sites. This allows objects to be viewed from multiple angles at once - providing high accuracy that increases detection confidence, positioning, track continuity, and coverage resilience. The Ericsson ISAC System uses parts of the 5G mobile network infrastructure - such as towers, backhaul and spectrum - already in place across cities, transport corridors and strategic locations to provide tracking data and AI-based classification. This data can be securely shared through standardized interfaces with authorized external systems, including security and command and control systems. Combined with data from other sensors and mitigation platforms, it can give users a more complete operational picture, helping them respond faster and make more informed decisions. In validated tests, the system reliably detected and tracked micro drones at kilometer-scale distances with precise 3D positioning. Testing demonstrated consistent detection and tracking across a range of operating conditions, system configurations and drone flight patterns. Actual performance depends on factors such as the characteristics and flight profile of the target, sensing geometry, terrain and surrounding environment, and system configuration. Evaluated in live 5G demonstrations Trials with AT&T in Arlington, Texas, used sensing dashboards to display drone activity. Combining Ericsson technology with AT&T's network expertise, the trial detected, located multiple drones, and tracked their movements, illustrating how wireless infrastructure could help protect major venues, critical infrastructure and other key locations. A separate demonstration with Erillisverkot in Helsinki showed multiple 5G sites detecting and tracking drones, demonstrating how network sensing can support public safety and counter-UAS (Unmanned Aircraft System) operations while extending coverage alongside traditional sensors. In Poland, Ericsson, Asseco and Play demonstrated how Ericsson's Integrated Sensing and Communication technology, Play's mobile network and Asseco's PUSZCZYK acoustic detection system could support detection and positioning of low-flying drones with higher accuracy. Potential applications Defense and public safety: Enhancing airspace monitoring across borders, coastlines and strategic assets. Critical infrastructure: Strengthening protection for ports, power plants and other vital sites. Transport and industry: Supporting safer operations across road, rail and industrial environments. Low-altitude economy: Drone traffic management, urban airspace monitoring, and digital twins for smart-city planning and environmental mapping. Freddie Södergren, Global Head of Mission Critical Networks and Defense, Ericsson, says: "Low-flying drones create a detection coverage gap that no single sensor can effectively address. Ericsson ISAC System enables multiple 5G sites to deliver coordinated wide-area detection and continuous tracking, with data that can be integrated with traditional sensing technologies and operational systems. It also gives operators a pathway to create new services from existing network assets." Joe Madden, Principal Analyst at Mobile Experts, says: "Ericsson's ISAC System shows that mobile-network sensing can perform far better than many expect, turning complex radio reflections into remarkably accurate tracking of low-flying, uncooperative objects. By building on an extensive footprint of existing sites, Ericsson has the potential to deliver wide-area drone detection faster and more cost-efficiently than deploying new dedicated sensor infrastructure." Carl Lundqvist, Chief Architect, Swedish Armed Forces HQ, says: "Detecting small drones across large areas is a growing operational challenge. The possibility of using distributed infrastructure to complement existing sensors could provide an important additional layer of situational awareness." Shawn Hakl, SVP & Head of Product, AT&T Business, says: "The next evolution of connectivity is about networks that don't just move data but help organizations with insights to better understand and respond to the events in the real world. Bringing Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) capabilities into existing 5G infrastructure can provide telemetry and intelligence in situations where it is not possible or desirable to pre-deploy sensors or cameras. Deploying this technology in a complex environment like a stadium is an important example of how intelligent networks can drive better safety and security outcomes from infrastructure already in place." Antti Kauppinen, CTO, Erillisverkot, says: "The Ericsson ISAC System shows that dual-use technology can strengthen national security by extending sensing capabilities to help authorities protect people and critical infrastructure. Together with Ericsson, we are exploring how this capability can be developed responsibly to enhance Finland's resilience, security, and preparedness." results.title: Suntec City Turns Up the Festive Fun with The Ultimate Holiday Playdate, Featuring The Powerpuff Girls and We Bare Bears' Crossover
results.description: Power through a larger-than-life playground, meet-and-greets and exciting mall-wide rewards SINGAPORE, Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With the exciting crossover of The Powerpuff Girls and We Bare Bears, Suntec City Atrium (Tower 1 & 2) is set to transform into The Ultimate Holiday Playdate this festive season with an action packed lineup of physical play, meet-and-greet opportunities, carnival games and exclusive festive rewards adding to the celebrations. A BEARY FUN PLAYDATE WITH THE POWERPUFF GIRLS X WE BARE BEARS From 12 November to 27 December 2026, visitors can step into A Beary Fun Playdate, a festive experience featuring beloved characters and playful interactive zones. Open daily from 11am to 9.30pm, the experience is free for Suntec+ Members and brings the fun to life with two larger-than-life themed inflatables, the Mega Claw Machine and Super Slide, alongside an action-packed Lava Arena, designed to deliver playful, interactive fun for the whole family. Step into The Powerpuff Girls-themed towering Mega Claw Machine, an eye-catching five-metre-tall installation that invites little ones to dive into a colourful ball pit and imagine themselves as prizes inside a giant arcade game. Join Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear at the Super Slide, an inflatable playground where children can climb, roll and weave through the colourful obstacles before racing down the slide. Families can then put their speed to the test at the Lava Arena, navigating the floor-is-lava challenge while going head-to-head with friends and family. The excitement continues for those looking for even more festive action. Visitors can put their carnival game skills to the test with a lineup of The Powerpuff Girls and We Bare Bears' themed carnival games. From claw machines to fun-filled carnival games, there is something for everyone to put their skills to the test and share in the holiday fun. No Christmas adventure would be complete without a touch of superhero sparkle. Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup will be making special appearances for meet-and-greet sessions with fans. Catch the iconic crime fighting trio at the Lava Arena at 2pm, 4pm and 6pm every weekend starting from 14 November to 27 December 2026, as well as an exclusive appearance on Christmas Day. Simply spend a minimum of $30 in a single same-day transaction to receive a photo pass and get up close with The Powerpuff Girls. PLAY TO WIN, THEN SHOP TILL YOU DROP For those looking to bring home a little festive spirit, be sure to visit the Retail Pop-up, where fans can shop an exclusive collection of The Powerpuff Girls and We Bare Bears merchandise and keepsakes. From character themed collectibles to fun festive finds, the pop up offers the perfect opportunity to pick up a special memento of the experience or surprise fellow fans with a playful gift this Christmas. results.title: إصابة مخرج «Heat» بطلق ناري في لوس أنجلوس
results.description: لم يكن تدريب المخرج الأمريكي مايكل مان على الرماية يسير كالمعتاد، إذ تحوّل إلى حادث مفاجئ بعدما أصابته رصاصة في ساقه عن طريق الخطأ داخل أحد ميادين الرماية في لوس أنجلوس، ما استدعى نقله إلى المستشفى لتلقي العلاج، قبل أن يغادره في اليوم نفسه. وذكرت وسائل إعلام أمريكية أن الحادث وقع بعد ظهر السبت، أثناء ممارسة مان، البالغ من العمر 83 عاماً، للرماية، إذ انطلقت رصاصة بصورة غير مقصودة وأصابته في ساقه أثناء محاولته إعادة المسدس إلى الحافظة.وأشارت التحقيقات الأولية إلى أن إطلاق النار وقع عرضاً خلال التدريب، دون وجود مؤشرات على أن الحادث كان محاولة لإيذاء النفس.من جهته، أوضح المتحدث باسم المخرج أن الإصابة كانت بسيطة وسطحية، مشيراً إلى أن مان نُقل بسيارة إسعاف إلى المستشفى، حيث تلقى الرعاية الطبية اللازمة، قبل أن تسمح حالته بمغادرته والعودة إلى منزله في اليوم ذاته.ويُعد مايكل مان من الأسماء البارزة في الإخراج السينمائي الأمريكي، إذ ارتبط اسمه بأعمال تركت حضوراً لافتاً في هوليوود، من بينها أفلام «Heat» الذي عُرض عام 1995، و«The Last of the Mohicans»، و«The Insider»، و«Collateral»، إضافة إلى «Miami Vice».وفي سياق مشروعاته المقبلة، يعمل مان على التحضير للجزء الثاني من فيلم «Heat»، تحت عنوان «Heat 2»، وهو المشروع الذي يضم، وفق المعلومات الواردة، النجمين ليوناردو دي كابريو وكريستيان بيل ضمن قائمة أبطاله.
creator: "عكاظ" (واشنطن)
